PROVIDER_EVIDENCE_SEQUENCE.statement: This is a RECORDED ORDERING for a future authority to follow, NOT an authorization to perform any of it. Every step below remains blocked by OD-A (and, for step 7, by OD-C) and by the not-yet-opened companion provider-evidence authority.

That substitution is exactly what OD-B forecloses.

metadata_only_ceiling.rule: If metadata inventory is ambiguous — for example if project or issuing-control-plane identity (step 1/2) cannot be established from metadata alone — the correct outcome is STOP_METADATA_ONLY_CEILING_REACHED.
metadata_only_ceiling.explicit_prohibition: Do NOT silently escalate into OD-B (candidate-key-string retrieval) to resolve that ambiguity. Escalation past the metadata-only ceiling requires a new, separate human decision, exactly as OD-B's own reopening_condition states.

what_it_is_not: It is NOT confirmation of no misuse.
It is NOT proof of compromise.

SEVERITY_BOUNDARY.statement: This owner record does NOT itself change severity. Effective severity remains MEDIUM_PENDING_PROVIDER_CONFIRMATION (v1.0.1 S-4) until measured provider evidence supports a successor adjudication that explicitly revises it.
prohibited_inferences: Do NOT infer COMPROMISED from exposure alone.
Do NOT infer COMPROMISED from public-repository status alone.
Do NOT infer COMPROMISED from a finding that the key is live.
Do NOT infer COMPROMISED from missing or decayed provider evidence.
SEVERITY_BOUNDARY.compromise_standard: COMPROMISED requires affirmative evidence of unauthorized use. Its absence, or the absence of evidence either way, leaves COMPROMISED at NOT_ESTABLISHED — it does not itself prove or disprove anything.
